svg.title: Warehouse VR training — top-down floor plan
svg.desc: Top-down layout of the warehouse showing zones for all four training modules: Safety, Order Picking, Packing and Dispatch, and Route Optimisation, with aisles, shelving rows, packing station, conveyor, PPE station, hazard markers, and muster point.
svg.text: Zone boundary markers · AI path overlay · forklift congestion point
